claims.value: Vasari: Leonardo painted the angel on the left
claims.statement: Vasari's Life of Verrocchio states that Leonardo, as a young pupil, painted an angel in Verrocchio's Baptism. That Vasari says this is a fact about the text; it is a narrative source written some eighty years later.

claims.value: Collaboration: Verrocchio workshop with passages by Leonardo (left angel, landscape)
claims.statement: The Uffizi credits the panel to Verrocchio with Leonardo; the allocation of the left angel and parts of the landscape to Leonardo is a connoisseurship judgement, supported but not proven by Vasari's account.
